voiceSummary: Zodiac Ventures Limited filed its standalone and consolidated audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Standalone total income was Rs. 464.84 lakhs, with a net profit after tax of Rs. 64.60 lakhs. Consolidated total income was Rs. 116.90 lakhs, showing a net loss after tax of Rs. 111.12 lakhs. Earnings per share were Rs. 0.08 basic and diluted for standalone figures. For consolidated results, earnings per share were negative Rs. 68.91. The company also disclosed the appointment of Mr. Ramesh Shah as Director. Additionally, Zodiac Ventures Limited reported the transfer of unclaimed dividends to the Investor Education and Protection Fund. The announcement includes details regarding the transfer of shares and other routine corporate disclosures.

attchmntText: Team India Guaranty Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Team India Guaranty Limited filed its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, with the National Stock Exchange on November 13, 2026. The Limited Review Report by V. B. Gaels & Co. states that nothing came to their attention indicating material misstatements. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a net profit of 15.88 lakhs, compared to a net loss of 18.56 lakhs in the same period last year. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the net profit was 22.37 lakhs, versus a net loss of 16.24 lakhs in the previous year. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, stood at 8,412.42 lakhs. Equity share capital remained at 900.21 lakhs. The results are subject to final scrutiny and shareholder approval where applicable.

attchmntText: Team India Guaranty Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Team India Guaranty Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results include a limited review report from statutory auditors V. B. Gaels & Co. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a net profit of 15.88 lakhs. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the net profit was 22.37 lakhs. The Board meeting commenced at 04:07 P.M. and concluded at 04:32 P.M. The company was formerly known as Times Guaranty Limited. The financial results are filed pursuant to Regulations 30 and 33 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.
